title: Kathanayagan
desc: A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Maareesan
desc: Dhaya, a thief, sets out on a journey with Velayudham, who has Alzheimer's disease, intending to loot him. However, the trip ends up changing their lives forever.

title: Surya's Saturday
desc: Surya, a young man with anger issues, channels his emotions on Saturdays, because of a promise to his deceased mother. However, things get complicated when he decides to confront a corrupt cop.

title: Joe
desc: Following heartbreak from his university sweetheart, Joe embraces the concept of an arranged marriage, seeking a fresh beginning.

title: Sadugudu Vandi
desc: Shiva, struggling to find a decent job, finally takes up the job of a cab driver. However, things take an eerie and spooky turn when mysterious deaths start happening in the cab.

title: D Block
desc: When the female students of an engineering college mysteriously disappear and are found dead, a young man and his friends decide to look for the culprit.

title: Magadheera
desc: After waking from a coma with a new face, a man seeks vengeance on the thug who killed his lover. However, as he battles his enemies, he uncovers shocking truths about his identity and past.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A compilation of catchy and entertaining popular songs composed by famed artists and musicians from varied Tamil movies.

title: Irandaam Ulagam
desc: Madhu, traumatised by the sudden deaths of his father and girlfriend, tries to commit suicide, but is rescued by a stranger who looks exactly like him and transported to a distant planet.

title: Mundasupatti
desc: Gopi, a professional photographer, goes to a remote village along with his friend. However, the villagers are suspicious about their cameras.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Yamakaathaghi
desc: After the demise of a young woman, her spirit remains inside her funeral home and refuses to leave. Soon, her death leads to a disturbing supernatural investigation.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Vettai
desc: An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.
